paragraphs.text: Outcasters are scattered groups of hermits and outlaws that huddle in small ramshackle towns across Thunder Junction .

Outcasters are survivalists who keep in touch with nature and help the land grow. They are known to travel with loyal animal companions. Preferring solitude, they find endless wonder in the natural world. Whether exploring unmapped territory or conducting natural experiments, so long as you don't bother them, they don't bother you.
The Outcasters tend to use natural materials to dress, usually depicted wearing heavy fur shoulder pads or cloaks, fur-lined armor, cactus armor plates, horns, and spikes.
